title: Pool access during a lift test
titleZh: 泳池升降椅測試期間的入場安排
passage:
Cypress Pool | Wednesday access note
The main pool opens at 7 a.m. on Wednesday. The warm pool opens at 9 a.m. Both use the usual entrance and changing rooms.
Staff will test the main-pool lift at 8:30. Before they confirm the test is complete, swimmers who need help entering the water should ask reception to reserve a place in the warm pool. Its ramp is independent of the lift test. Do not enter the main pool by lift until a staff member confirms it is available.
A morning ticket normally covers only the pool named on the ticket. If a lift user changes pools on staff advice, reception can transfer the main-pool ticket to the warm pool at no charge. The transfer does not open the warm pool early, and it cannot be done at the poolside gate.
passageZh:
柏樹泳池｜星期三入場通知
星期三主池上午七點開放，溫水池上午九點開放。兩池都沿用原本的入口和更衣室。
工作人員八點半會測試主池的升降椅。在工作人員確認測試完成前，需要協助下水的泳客應請櫃檯預留溫水池名額。溫水池的坡道不受升降椅測試影響。工作人員確認升降椅可用之前，請勿用它進入主池。
晨間票通常只能使用票上指定的泳池。使用升降椅的泳客若依工作人員建議換池，櫃檯可免費將主池票轉為溫水池票。轉票不會使溫水池提早開放，池畔入口也不能辦理轉票。
